notes: Total 60 as published, though the 'Effects (8)' header lists nine Effects (Visage Of The Emperor x2 included).
Starting: the strategy says 'Start PotF on the Med Chamber'.

The description calls it 'a pre-Wizard World version of Markley's Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi deck, modified to my taste'; it differs from [[1999 Wizards tournament Jason Markley DS]] (Sense, Alter, Nal Hutta, Security Precautions, Oppressive Enforcement in; Lateral Damage, Unexpected Interruption out; different counts), so it is filed as Lamantia's own list.
Battle Order, Come Here You Big Coward and Oppressive Enforcement are the 1999 Effects, not the later Defensive Shields.
